description: Grouped resources in the Svelte 5 scheduler: providers organised into a collapsible tree in the timeline gutter, buildings to departments to providers and rooms, through resourceGroups and resourceGroupOf. collapsibleGroups lets a click fold a group and groupPersistKey remembers it; appointments schedule onto the leaf providers with drag, resize and double-click to add, and the Table reads the same rows.

faq.question: How are groups defined?
faq.answer: resourceGroups lists the groups with ids, titles and parents, and resourceGroupOf maps each resource to its group, so the gutter renders the tree and the rows nest under it.

faq.question: Can events be scheduled on a group?
faq.answer: No. Groups are headings; events belong to leaf resources, and collapsing a group hides its providers' rows without changing the data.

faq.question: Is the collapsed state remembered?
faq.answer: Yes. groupPersistKey stores which groups are collapsed in localStorage and restores it on load.
